ui.setup.lead:
Partners ask fast, out loud, and cut you off. So does this.
      Four voices, a timer, a written record of every answer. Free. Nothing leaves your device.
ui.setup.indhint: Picks which three YC partners sit on your simulated panel in the report.
ui.setup.michint: Audio and text stay in this tab. Turn the mic off to type instead.
ui.setup.keys: <kbd>Space</kbd> or <kbd>Enter</kbd> ends an answer early · <kbd>Esc</kbd> ends the interview
ui.rep.readhint: This is exactly what "Copy partner-panel prompt" puts on your clipboard. Edit a transcript above and it updates.
ui.rep.whisper: Improve transcripts with on-device Whisper (optional, ~40 MB download, runs in your browser)
ui.rep.whisperhint: Live transcription is fast but rough. Whisper re-listens to each recording on this device. Nothing is uploaded.
ui.rep.answershint: Transcripts are editable. Fix anything before you copy the prompt.
ui.tip.1: Paste the prompt into Claude, ChatGPT or any model you trust. Three simulated YC partners, matched to your industry, score every answer and say what they would push on.
ui.tip.2: Cut every answer in half. Partners want the number, the name, the date. Not the story.
ui.tip.3: Fix the cut-offs first. An interrupted answer is one that started with context instead of the point.
ui.tip.4: Go again. The cut comes at a different moment every run. If the point is out in the first 8 seconds, it survives the real room.
ui.foot.1: Free forever. No AI, no server, no tracking: everything runs in your browser.
ui.foot.2: Questions from yci.vercel.app. Not affiliated with Y Combinator.
ui.stage.pre: Not launched yetNo metric questions
ui.mode.interrupt: Partners interruptNo clock. A partner cuts in when they feel like it, 4 to 45 s, usually early. Deep questions get more.
ui.mode.fixed: Strict timerFixed time per answer. Warning at 75%.
ui.ph.summary: One sentence, the way you would say it to a partner. Example: Same-day payroll for restaurant staff, no bank account needed.
ui.ph.typed: Type your answer. Ctrl+Enter (or ⌘+Enter) moves on.
